command: cat /data/nextflow.config && nextflow run https://github.com/nf-core/scrnaseq -r 2.7.1 -c /data/nextflow.config --input /data/samplesheet.csv -with-report gs://bioaf-raw-test/nextflow-reports/bioaf-pipeline-101-1790000000/report.html -with-trace gs://bioaf-raw-test/nextflow-traces/bioaf-pipeline-101-1790000000/trace.tsv --aligner star --genome GRCh38 --outdir gs://bioaf-results-test/experiments/9/pipeline-runs/101 --protocol 10XV3
containers.name: pipeline

command:
cat > /data/nextflow.config << 'NFEOF'
process.executor = 'k8s'
k8s.namespace = 'bioaf-pipelines'
k8s.serviceAccount = 'bioaf-pipeline-runner'
process.pod = [[label: 'bioaf.io/run-id', value: '101']]
workDir = 'gs://bioaf-raw-test/nextflow-work/run-101'
wave.enabled = true
fusion.enabled = true
fusion.exportStorageCredentials = true
process.resourceLimits = [cpus: 14, memory: '110.GB']
process.disk = { "120.GB" }
process.maxRetries = 3
process.errorStrategy = { task.exitStatus in [143, 137, 247] ? (task.attempt <= 3 ? 'retry' : 'finish') : (task.attempt <= 2 ? 'retry' : 'finish') }
k8s.pod = [[annotation: 'cluster-autoscaler.kubernetes.io/safe-to-evict', value: 'false'], [nodeSelector: 'bioaf.io/pool=pipelines'], [toleration: [key: 'bioaf.io/pool', operator: 'Equal', value: 'pipelines', effect: 'NoSchedule']]]
docker.enabled = true
process { withName: 'MULTIQC' { ext.args = '--export' } }
process { withName: 'STAR_ALIGN' { ext.args = '--readFilesCommand zcat --runDirPerm All_RWX --outWigType bedGraph --twopassMode Basic --outSAMtype BAM SortedByCoordinate --limitBAMsortRAM 59055800320' } }
NFEOF
initContainers.name: write-nf-config
